READ	SELECT c, max(a) FROM test_having
READ	SELECT min(a), max(a) FROM test_having HAVING min(a) = max(a)
READ	SELECT min(a), max(a) FROM test_having HAVING min(a) < max(a)
READ	SELECT a FROM test_having HAVING min(a) < max(a)
READ	SELECT 1 AS one FROM test_having HAVING a > 1
READ	SELECT 1 AS one FROM test_having HAVING 1 > 2
READ	SELECT 1 AS one FROM test_having HAVING 1 < 2
READ	SELECT 1 AS one FROM test_having WHERE 1/a = 1 HAVING 1 < 2
